initial_fragility.description: Default bank_fragility when absent from state. ∈ [0,1].

base.description: Baseline monthly fragility accumulation rate (always positive).

loose_policy_weight.description: Weight applied to max(0, -realGap): loose policy breeds fragility.

easing_weight.description: Weight applied to max(0, easingSpeed): sustained easing breeds fragility.

lax_weight.description: Weight applied to (1 - supervisoryRigor): lax supervision compounds fragility.

supervisory_decay.description: Fragility decay multiplier for fragilityMitigation input ∈ [0,1].

natural_decay.description: Unconditional monthly fragility decay (baseline healing rate).
